llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The new CompactWithTombstones method must be added to the Compactor interface in prometheus/tsdb, implemented by LeveledCompactor using a TombstoneAwareBlockPopulator that merges caller-supplied tombstones with source block tombstones during compaction. Thanos and Mimir must update their respective Compactor interfaces and compaction logic to call this new method and remove the output block's tombstone file, enabling explicit tombstone injection without modifying source blocks.

FILES:
- prometheus/tsdb/compact.go — Add CompactWithTombstones to Compactor interface and implement TombstoneAwareBlockPopulator
- prometheus/tsdb/tombstones/tombstones.go — Reference tombstones.Reader type for the method signature
- thanos/pkg/compact/compact.go — Update Compactor interface and Group.compact to call CompactWithTombstones
- mimir/pkg/compactor/bucket_compactor.go — Update Compactor interface and runCompactionJob to call CompactWithTombstones
